name: pilot-production-verification-adapter
purpose: Verify the deployed production outcome independently from deployment-provider success.

rules.deployment_not_verification: A DEPLOYED result alone must never become PRODUCTION_VERIFIED.
rules.provider_neutral: Production verification must consume a provider-neutral contract rather than Vercel-specific success fields.
rules.failure_preserves_state: Blocked, failed, or degraded verification preserves deployment/release evidence for retry or recovery.
rules.no_extra_deploy: Running production verification must not itself trigger another deployment.
